notes.title: 2025 Year of the Snake! More bonuses! More music! More themes! More good wishes!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45199507/72cb9fa577013a8176819b65c59f3ab9359ebddd.png[/img]

[h1]Bonus Score[/h1]

In traditional spider solitaire games, score calculation is only related to steps consumed during collecting cards. Now everything has changed!!!

From now on, extra bonus score is given to players who have played this game with hardcore operations. Currently many different bonus types have been implemented in the game, including:

[list]
[*]All Issued Collect:All cards are issued when collecting cards for first 4 times.
[*]Issue to Collect:Issuing cards instantly initiates collecting of cards.
[*]Collect In Time:Collecting cards within 60/120/240 (by difficulty) seconds after game start.
[*]Collect In Steps:Collecting cards within 26/39/42 (by difficulty) steps after game start.
[*]Collect With Slots:Empty slot exists when collecting cards for first 4 times.
[*]Never Cancel:Initial bonus is +1/5/10  (by difficulty) , deducted by taking cancellations.
[*]Never Hint:Initial bonus is +1/2/4  (by difficulty) , deducted by using hints.
[*]Never Use Tool:Initial bonus is +1/5/10  (by difficulty) , deducted by using tools.
[*]Combo 100:Hit combos that are multiples of 100.
[*]Streak Bonus:Bonus score for streak winning. Up to a maximum of 500 streaks.
[*]Same Suit:The suits of the collecting cards are same as the last collecting.
[*]All Visible:All cards are visible before issuing cards.
[*]Flip Streak:Flipping cards in a row. 
[*]Collect Streak:Collecting cards in a row.
[*]Issue Streak:Issuing cards in a row.
[*]Issue With Slots:Empty slot exists when issuing cards.
[*]Long Tail Collect:Collecting cards from a stack with over 20 cards.
[*]All Straight Flushes:All face-up cards are straight flushes before issuing cards.
[*]Issued A/K:Receive K or A by issuing cards.
[*]New Straight Flush:Issued card complete a straight flush with existed stack.
[*]Flip Same Stack:Flipping cards from same stack in a row. 
[/list]

[h1]Music Player[/h1]

A new music player is add to the game to add some tune for your leisure hours. All the songs are generated by AI and all the lyrics are about playing spider solitaire games. Hope that you will like it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45199507/51581eadc88b9c425a6af808ff7a89cece7fe026.png[/img]

[h1]More themes[/h1]

As you can see in the header image, 6 new themes has been on sale, go check it in the shop!

notes.title: New functions released! Boss Mode set you free! Endless Mode any score possible!
notes.content:
[h1]Boss Mode[/h1]

In boss mode, your game window will dock at the right bottom corner, when your cursor moved out of the game window, an advertisement look with a close button appears like this:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45199507/2dc718b681332ca438f84c3bb8f05262820a1116.png[/img]

Only if you click the grey button with text 'Try 30 days for free!', the normal game content will appear again, like this:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45199507/353946e371f484d0445a1eec8f18938013f42816.png[/img]

If you click the 'X' button of the advertisement page, the game will be closed.

[h1]Endless Mode[/h1]

When you try to start a new game, you can choose to start an endless game other than a classic one. The difference is, [u][b]an endless game will only end when all the cards in the pile at bottom right corner are placed on the table. If you start a new game before finishing current game, your score will not be recorded!!! [/b][/u]

You can get unlimited high score in an endless game!

You can switch your game mode to endless mode by clicking the text showing the type of next new game until it shows '<Endless>', then choose a difficulty to kick it off, just like this:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45199507/a40b560b5d868fab1952071945ede5f8f127d175.png[/img]
